newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson sees Infocom Systems profitability up '98.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson sees Infocom Systems profitability up '98.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Friday its troubled business area Infocom Systems was expected to boost profitability next year.
"We are expecting this business area to move from its present break even level to a satisfactory profitability next year," chief financial officer Carl Wilhelm Ros told the annual general meeting.
Infocom Systems, which makes switches and fixed company networks, posted a 25 percent increase in first quarter sales to 9.28 billion crowns.
Ericsson earlier released first quarter earnings showing pre-tax profit rose 30 percent to 2.02 billion crowns, while net sales rose to 30.71 billion crowns from 22.66 billion.
Ros stressed that the unit's AXE switching equipment showed good profitability, while problems could be found elsewhere in the business area.
Kurt Hellstrom, head of Infocom Systems, said the business area planned large investments in data communication.
"This is of course large investments for us, but we believe that we can sustain them within our own business area," Hellstrom said.
